(ga)༄༅/ /dpal phyag na rdo rje 'byung po 'dul byed me dbang ma bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ /bla ma dang dpal phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das

tei:div.tei:p: (ga)༄༅// dpal phyag na rdo rje 'byung po 'dul byed me dbang ma bzhugs so// ༄༅// bla ma dang dpal phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo// bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje sems dpa' sum brtsegs bsgom par 'dod pas/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i gnas su stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ skad cig gis bdag nyid phyag na rdo rje 'byung po 'dul byed du gsal ba'i snying ga'i hūm̐ mthing nag las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bla ma dang phyag na rdo rje 'byung po 'dul byed kyi lha tshogs la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ na mo badzra pā ṇi sa pa ri wā re bhyaḥ oṃ bha ga wān sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha dang*/ puṣpe/ sogs kyis mchod nas/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi tshar gsum brjod/ tshad med bzhi bsgom/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dha rmaḥswa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las padma dang*/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa de las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ khor yug rdo rje'i rwa ba dang drwa ba/ steng rdo rje'i gur dang bla bre/ phyi rol thams cad ye shes kyi me 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar pam̐ las padma dang*/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus gcig tu gyur pa las/ rang nyid phyag na rdo rje 'byung po 'dul byed sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag bzhi/ rtsa phyag gnyis hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ g.yas gnyis pas gnam lcags kyi rdo rje 'phyar ba'i tshul gyis dgra bgegs la snun par byed pa/ g.yon gnyis pas zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub me 'bar ba brkyangs pa'i tshul gyis dgra bgegs la bsdigs par mdzad pa/

zhal mche ba gtsigs shing ljags 'dril ba/ spyan gsum dmar la zlum zhing bsgrad pa/ sma ra dang smin ma dbu skra dmar ser gyen la 'bar ba/ nor rgyas sogs klu chen po brgyad kyis brgyan zhing*/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs gsol ba/ ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas khro chung tshon gang bas gtams pa/ zhabs g.yas cung zad bskums pa/ g.yon brkyangs pa'i stabs kyis gzhan gyis mi thub pa la sogs pa 'byung po'i tshogs thams cad mnan pa ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i sku can du gsal ba'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar pad nyi'i steng du rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa' tshon gang pa/ de'i thugs kar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' hūm̐ mthing nag skras bris pa lta bu phra zhing phra ba zhig gsal gdab/ hūm̐ de las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad phyag na rdo rje 'byung po 'dul byed kyi rnam par oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ khyed rnams kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lha bcom ldan 'das kyis/ oṃ badzrī bha ba a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ oṃ bha ga wān badzra pā ṇi sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pā dyaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ lcang lo can gyi gnas mchog dam pa nas shlo ka gcig gis bstod/ hūm̐ badzra phaṭa/ brgya rtsa sogs ci nus bzla/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad la 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes dngos grub blang*/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag ces sogs smon lam btab bo// ༈ /gsum pa rjes gnang bya tshul ni/

maṇḍal gyi steng du tshom bu gcig bkod/ de'i g.yon du gtor ma che ba rgyan dang ldan pa/ de nyid kyi mtha' skor du chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa/ gtor ma gcig bsham/ sumbhas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang du oṃ āḥhūm̐ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri mchog zhal zas/ ro mo'i sgra la sogs pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ oṃ arghaṃ sogs kyi byin gyis brlab rol chen bya/ de nas bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa sgrub thabs bzhin bya/ mdun bskyed kyi tshom bu dang gtor ma che ba sumbha nis bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las de gnyis ka hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa hūm̐ gis mtshan pa re rer bsam/ de las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ de gnyis ka sgrub thabs bzhin/ phyag na rdo rje 'byung po'i 'dul byed sems dpa' sum brtsegs ye shes pa dgug gzhug dbang bskur rigs bdag gis rgyas btab pa mchod bstod bzlas pa rnams sgrub thabs bzhin bya/ gtor ma sumbhas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i rgya mtsho chen por bsam la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyi byin gyis brlab/ oṃ bha ga wān badzra pā ṇi sa pa ri wā ra oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ ā dya nutpanna twāta oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa lan gsum mam lngas yi dam la phul/ sngar bzhin mchod bstod bya/ dngos grub blang*/ slar yang*/ ma hā bhū ta sa pa ri wā ra a kā ro btags pa lan gsum mam bdun gyis 'phul nas/ 'jig rten skyong ba'i lha rnams dang*// lha srin sde brgyad 'khor bcas rnams// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// dpal dang grags dang skal pa bzang*// longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing*// zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi// las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol// dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs// dngos grub kun gyi stong grogs mdzod// dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*// gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod// rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan// bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod// 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*// 'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel ba// dge legs thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas// yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog

/mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la bgegs med cing las kyi dngos grub kyang stsal du gsol zhes brjod la/ slob ma rnams khrus byas gral la 'khod pa la me tog bkye bsdu bya/ nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du zab pa las kyang ches shin tu zab pa'i phyag na rdo rje 'byung po 'dul byed kyi rjes su gnang ba dang*/ dbang bskur ba zab mo gsan nas thugs nyams su bzhes snyam pa'i thugs bskyed rnam par dag pa gsal btab nas gsan 'tshal/ de yang ma rungs pa gdul dka' ba rnams 'dul ba'i mchog tu bsngags pa dpal phyag na rdo rje yin la/ de la'ang che ba drug gi rnam gzhag mdzad de/ 'khor lo chen po dbang gi che ba/ gtum po khyung gi che ba/ 'gro bzang chos skyong gi che ba/ be con can rgyud kyi che ba/ u tsārya drag sngags kyi che ba/ 'byung po 'dul byed mthu stobs dang nus pas che ba rnams su yod pa las/ 'dir 'byung po 'dul byed/ de la'ang lugs du ma yod pa las sems dpa' sum brtsegs kyi rjes gnang sgrub pa'i skabs su babs pa yin/ de la slob dpon gyi bya ba rnams grub zin nas/ rdo rje slob ma rnams rjes su 'dzin pa la sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi rjes dang gsum/ dang po la gsum las thog mar rjes gnang zab mo zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal 'bul du gzhug gnyis pa la/ nyan sogs 'dod pas gsol gsum btab// ces pa ltar 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// lhag pa'i lha yi ngo bo nyid// dpal ldan bla ma'i bka' drin gyis// bdag la rjes gnang stsal du gsol// zhes gsol ba lan gsum btab/ gsum pa rgyun bshags bya ba ni/ dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ rdo rje slob dpon dang*/ mdun bskyed gnyis ka phyag na rdo rje dngos yin snyam du bsam/

mdun gyi nam mkhar phyag na rdo rje 'byung po 'dul byed la yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba sprin gtibs pa bzhin bzhugs pa de dag gi spyan sngar rang gi tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad bshags/ rang gzhan gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad la rjes su yi rang ba bsgom/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba'i sgo nas smon pa dang 'jug pa'i bdag nyid can gyi byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed snyam du bsam la 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs lan gsum brjod du gzhug thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang*/ slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag la bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje 'byung po 'dul byed kyi sku gsung thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba dang*/ dbang bskur ba ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ lan gsum/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la bgegs bsal ba ni/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas khro bo bgegs mthar byed dpag tu med pa spros/ khyed rang rnams kyi rgyud la rtogs pa khyad par can bskyed pa la bar du gcod par byed pa'i dgra bgegs log 'dren thams cad phyi'i rgya mtsho chen po'i mthar bskrad par bsams la/ slob dpon gyis sumbha ni'i sngags dang rol mo drag tu bya/ bgegs bsal nas sku'i rjes gnang gi don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon phyag na rdo rje 'byung po 'dul byed du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ slob ma rang gi lus kyi cha shas la phog pas/ tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad mun khung du sgron me bteg pa bzhin song ste yal/ rnam smin sha khrag gdos bcas kyi lus 'od du mer gyis zhu/ phyi bltas nang gsal/

nang bltas phyi gsal ba'i 'od kyi gong bur gyur/ de nyid skad cig gis pam̐ las padma/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa nas/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin bskyed/ de ltar gsal ba'i thugs kar pam̐ las padma/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' tshon gang pa/ de'i thugs kar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' hūm̐ mthing nag spus bris pa lta bur bsams la gus 'dud drag por byas pas/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ de thams cad kyi thugs ka dang lcang lo can gyi gnas mchog dam pa sogs nas phyag na rdo rje'i sku che ba ri rab tsam/ 'bring ba mi tshad tsam/ tha ma yungs kar tsam dpag tu med pa byon/ spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga nas bzung*/ lus kyi cha shas thams cad du rdo tshan la kha ba babs pa bzhin sib sib thim pa'i dmigs pa mdzod byas la/ slob dpon gyi dril bu gsil ba dang*/ hūm̐ badzra phaṭa mang du brjod pa'i mthar/ oṃ badzra ā be sha ya aḥ.āḥ rol chen bya/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho/ de brtan par bya ba'i phyir du tiṣṭa badzras mgor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag des sku'i rjes su gnang ba thob/ lus kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad dag sku bsgom pa la dbang*/ mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i sku lus rnam par dag pa thob pa'i phan yon yod do// gsung gi rjes gnang gi don du bzlas lung ni/ rang nyid sngar bzhin sems dpa' sum brtsegs su gsal btab/ gus 'dud drag po byas pas/ slob dpon sems dpa' sum brtsegs su gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las sngags kyi phreng ba byung ba zhal nas thon/

rang gi zhal du zhugs/ snying ga'i hūm̐ la thim par bsams la/ hūm̐ badzra phaṭa/ gsung gi rjes zlos dang*/ slob mas/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyis// bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// lan gsum brjod la me tog phul/ slob dpon gyis/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyis// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// zhes lan gsum brjod la me tog dor/ dam bca' ba'i lung ni/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje 'byung po 'dul byed yi dam gyi lhar bzung bar bgyi'o lan gsum brjod/ byin gyis brlab pa'i lung ni/ rig pa 'dzin pa 'di rnams la bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje 'byung po 'dul byed kyi byin rlabs dang dngos grub ma lus pa myur du 'jug par gyur cig sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol// des gsung gi rjes su gnang ba thob/ ngag gi sgo nas bsags pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad dag gsung bzlas pa la dbang*/ gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu thob pa'i phan yon yod do// thugs kyi rjes gnang gi don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ gus 'dud drag po byas pas/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ 'od zer 'phros phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ de thams cad kyi thugs ka nas rdo rje sngon po che ba ri rab tsam/ chung ba nas 'bras tsam dpag tu med pa byung nas/ rang gi lus kyi cha shas thams cad du thim pas rdo rje'i go bgos par gyur/ slar yang mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas mar me gcig las gnyis mched pa'i tshul gyis phyag na rdo rje tshon gang pa cig rang gi spyi bo nas byon/ snying ga'i ye shes sems dpa' la thim par bsam/

des thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba thob sems kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad dag thugs rnam par mi rtog pa bsgom pa la dbang*/ shes bya ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa mkhyen pa thob pa'i phan yon yod do// gtor ma'i dbang bskur ni/ gtor ma yi dam gyi lhar bskyed pa de slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag slob dpon gyis/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs kyis byin brlabs shing*// dngos grub ma lus 'byung ba'i gnas// gtor ma'i dbang bskur chen po sbyin// zhes bka' bsgos pas 'od du mer gyis zhu/ rang gi spyi bo nas thim pas/ yi dam gyi sku gsung thugs dang rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dbyer med du bsams la rol chen bya/ mtha' rten me dbang rnam bzhi ni/ gnam lcags me yi ting 'dzin/ mgal me lta bu'i ting 'dzin/ me 'bar klong chen gyi ting 'dzin/ 'phro 'du khro bo'i ting nge 'dzin no// ting nge 'dzin gyi don ni dmigs pa la rtse gcig tu gnas pa min pas thugs ma yengs pa gal che/ dang po ni slob ma rang nyid sngar bzhin sems dpa' sum brtsegs su gsal btab/ gus 'dud drag po byas pas/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i ting 'dzin sems dpa' las 'od 'phros/ rang gi snying ga'i ting 'dzin sems dpa' la thim pas rkyen byas 'od phram phram 'phros/ ye shes kyi me khab kyi rtse mo tsam 'bar/ de cher song hūm̐ gi yi ge me 'bar/ des rkyen byas ye shes sems dpa' las ye shes kyi me 'bar lus kyi nang thams cad khengs/ nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad bya sgro mes tshig pa bzhin thul gyis bsregs par bsam/ slob dpon gyis hūm̐ badzra phaṭa dang rol chen/ gnyis pa ye shes kyi me de cher 'bar te spyi bo rkang mthil gnyis nas 'thon/ lus kyi phyi rol du mgal me lta bu'i tshul du 'khor bas/ lus kyi phyi na gnas pa'i nad gdon dgra bgegs thams cad bya sgro mes tshig pa bzhin sogs gong bzhin bya/

gsum pa ni/ ye shes kyi me de cher 'bar bas gnas khang*/ lung pa/ gling bzhi/ gling phran brgyad/ stong spyi phud/ stong gnyis bar ma/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams na rang la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i dgra bgegs log par 'dren pa'i tshogs ji snyed yod pa thams cad bya sgro mes tshig pa sogs gong bzhin bya/ bzhi pa ni/ sngon gyi las stobs ldan bsags pa'i stobs kyis/ ye shes kyi mes bsregs par ma nus pa'i gdon bgegs 'dul ba'i phyir du/ dpon slob gnyis sems dpa' sum brtsegs su gsal ba'i ba spu'i bu ga dang*/ ye shes kyi me'i rtse mo re re la khro bo dpag tu med pa phyag na mtshon cha sna tshogs pa thogs pa spros/ dgra bgegs log 'dren sogs sha dum khrag dum du byas/ lus ngag thal ba'i rdul du brlag rnam shes mi bskyod zhing du bsgral/ hūm̐ badzra phaṭa dang rol mo drag tu bya'o// me dbang gdon gyis nyen pa rnams la bya yi thams cad du mi byed/ gsum pa rjes ni/ chos gsum ldan/ de dag gi skabs su khas blangs pa'i dam tshig rnams bla mas ji ltar bka' stsal ba ltar bsrung snyam pa gyis la/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa// de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi// lan gsum/ gtang rag tu maṇḍal/ de ltar lus longs spyod thams cad phul nas/ bla mas gang mkho mkho'i cha shas kyis longs spyad du gsol/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du// khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags na// khyed kyi slob mar bzung ba dang*// cha shas kyang ni spyad du gsol// zhes lan gsum brjod/ de ltar dbang bskur ba dang*/ rjes su gnang ba zab mo gsan pa yin pas rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen por mdzod/ bka' drin che'o// zhes brjod la rang gnas su gtang*/ zhes pa 'di ni bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje'i zhal dngos su mjal ba mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug bla chen shākya dpal ba nas brgyud de 'ongs pa/

rdo rje 'chang chen po chos dpal ba dang*/ chos rje rin po che bod 'brug pa gnyis las legs par thob cing lung nos pa/ rab 'byams pa rin chen bzang pos go bder sbyar ba'o// 'dis kyang bar du gcod pa'i bdud bzhi las rgyal nas sku bzhi'i bdag nyid rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang myur du thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ /gtor ma'i bka' bsgo'i tshe spro na tshigs su bcad pa'i mthar/ bcom ldan 'das dpal phyag na rdo rje 'byung po 'dul byed kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor los rdo rje slob ma 'di nyid kyi lus ngag yid gsum bya byed dang bcas pa la srung ba dang*/ skyob pa dang*/ sba bar mdzad du gsol/ 'di nyid la steng gdon gza' dang rgyu skar gyi gnod pa/ 'og gdon klu dang sa bdag gi gnod pa/ bar gdon 'byung po rgyal btsan gyi gnod pa/ gzhan yang gzugs can mi'i gnod pa/ gzugs med lha 'dre'i gnod pa/ pha rol gyi byad kha rbod gtong*/ mnan gtad gzir gsum la sogs pa 'jigs pa chen po brgyad dang bcu drug gis mtshon mi mthun mi 'dod pa'i phyogs thams cad nye bar zhi bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ mthun rkyen tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang 'byor pa snyan pa dang grags pa lung dang rtogs pa'i yon tan thams cad zla ba yar gyi ngo'am dbyar dus kyi mtsho ltar gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ khams gsum srid gsum gyi 'gro ba thams cad mthong thos dran reg tsam gyis khab len gyi rdo yis lcags phye bsdus pa ltar rang dbang med par dbang du 'du bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhi ba'i thabs kyis 'dul du ma 'tshal ba'i dgra bgegs 'byung po'i rigs thams cad/ dbye ba dang*/ bskrad pa dang*/ dgug pa dang*/ bsad pa la sogs pa drag shul gyi las chen rnam pa du mas rtsa sbur me yis sreg pa bzhin du tshar bcad par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/

gzhan yang ji ltar bsam pa'i don thams cad chos dang mthun par yid bzhin du 'grub cing mthar thug tshe 'di nyid la phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub dpal phyag na rdo rje 'byung po 'dul byed kyi go 'phang thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ mdor na 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa myur du thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes sbyar ro// maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
